lines.2: 「I hear you made up with Tsushima after things were so hostile.」
lines.5: 「I realized staying tense forever and causing trouble for everyone around us was kind of stupid.」
lines.6: 「A model-student answer. Very like you. I approve.」
lines.7: 「We didn't make up from the heart, so don't misunderstand.」
lines.8: 「Fair enough. Tsushima doesn't seem to have much ambition. You probably don't suit each other.」
lines.9: 「Exactly! That's what gets on my nerves!」
lines.10: 「Haha. And he looks pretty weak too.」
lines.12: 「...That gets on my nerves too, but he isn't weak.」
lines.14: 「Not enough for you to say that much about him.」
lines.15: 「Well, well. How kind of you, Ms. Konoe.」
lines.17: 「J-just because I dislike him doesn't mean I'll deny everything about him. I recognize his good points. That's only logical.」
lines.18: 「Love and hate are two sides of the same coin, right, Nishizaki?」
lines.20: 「Are you two making fun of me?」
lines.21: 「No, no. I was just thinking you're not very honest with yourself.」
lines.22: 「No jokes about my name! That gets on my nerves!」
lines.23: 「Found you! Found you! So you're the one with a catchphrase just like mine!」
lines.25: 「You don't even have a crest, so don't say things get on your crest!」
lines.26: 「That really gets on my crest, you hear!?」
lines.27: 「It's not copyrighted by you. I can say whatever I want.」
lines.28: 「Oho, surprise! A collaboration of astonishment and fury!」
lines.29: 「This twin-tail has the nerve to defy me!」
lines.30: 「I have no reason to obey you. That's perfectly logical, right?」
lines.31: 「Title: Twin-Tail Converses with Bird. Nishizaki, take the shot.」
lines.37: 「You treat us like idiots, but you're an idiot too.」
